## Filter-preparation checkpoint

Surveyed `origin/main` at `ae1bc8871273`. Project files remain unchanged.

- F08C remains as a bounded README completion candidate. Preserve the front door, tested quickstart, value proposition, concise installation path, supported interfaces, client navigation, and MCP ownership marker. Move or replace lower-page contributor setup, tests, configuration detail, interface contracts, and store internals only after their maintained destinations contain the required information.
- F28B is confirmed. The GitHub API reports `has_issues=true`, SUPPORT.md routes intake to Issues, and the mirror-lock runbook says Issues are disabled. Correct the runbook and append a historical correction to `irritable-junior-fairyfly`. Do not change repository settings.
- F35A remains as a path-stable lifecycle correction. Update the archive and experiment indexes, remove the stray archive token, add an implementation-status banner to the remediation plan, and label versioned plan-review criteria as experiment inputs. Preserve all corpora, scripts, results, and paths.
- F35B remains as a new ADR for the implemented plan-review batch-runner boundary. Mark the design note implemented and replace the source docstring pointer with the ADR. Preserve ADR 0003.
- F36A remains as a runbook cleanup. Replace activation proof with ticket and ADR pointers. Remove the obsolete Python matrix and measured latency. Preserve rollback, restoration, verification, failure handling, and vote-carry procedures.
- Broad F23, F26, F34B, F39, F40, and F41 work remains excluded. F24 and F05 remain deferred. F02, F03, and F04 remain rejected.
- GitHub has one unrelated Gerrit change under the shared automation account. No documentation change from this survey is open. The F46 through F49 worktree remains uncommitted and must not be duplicated.

Independent factual and taxonomy filters remain pending.
